what_its_for: This medicine is used to treat sudden attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in adults and teenagers. HAE is a rare condition that causes sudden, painful swelling in different parts of the body such as the hands, feet, face, stomach, throat, and genitals. This medicine helps stop these swelling attacks by replacing a protein your body is missing or not making enough of.
how_to_take: This medicine is given as a slow injection into your vein (intravenous or IV infusion) by a healthcare provider or by yourself if you have been properly trained. It comes as a powder that must be mixed with sterile water before use. Do not shake the mixture — gently swirl until the powder is fully dissolved. Always check the liquid for particles or color changes before using it. Never use it if it looks cloudy or has floating pieces in it. Follow all preparation steps exactly as your doctor or pharmacist has taught you.
dosing: The usual dose for adults and teenagers is based on your body weight. Your doctor will calculate the right dose for you. A second dose may be given if your symptoms do not improve after the first injection. Do not take more than two doses in a 24-hour period. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions for your dose.
missed_dose: This medicine is only used when you are having an HAE attack, so it is not taken on a regular daily schedule. If you feel an attack starting, use this medicine as soon as possible. Do not wait too long, as treating the attack early may help it resolve faster. If you are unsure when or how to use it, contact your doctor or emergency services right away.
storage: Store this medicine in a refrigerator between 36°F and 46°F (2°C to 8°C). Do not freeze it. Keep it in its original packaging to protect it from light. If needed, you may store it at room temperature (up to 77°F or 25°C) for no more than 8 months, but it must be used before the expiration date or within 8 months, whichever comes first. Once the medicine has been mixed with water, use it right away. Throw away any unused mixed medicine — do not save it for later. Keep this medicine out of reach of children.
what_to_avoid: Do not use this medicine if you are allergic to rabbits or rabbit-derived products, as this medicine is made using recombinant rabbit technology. Avoid injecting the medicine if the liquid looks cloudy or discolored. Do not shake the vial when mixing. Avoid skipping follow-up appointments with your doctor, as regular monitoring is important for managing your HAE.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or get emergency help right away if you experience: signs of a severe allergic reaction such as hives, rash, itching, difficulty breathing, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, dizziness, or a rapid heartbeat; swelling of the throat or tongue that is making it difficult to breathe or swallow (this is a medical emergency — call 911 immediately); your symptoms do not improve or get worse after treatment; you have any unusual or new symptoms after using this medicine.
when_it_works: This medicine usually starts working within a few hours of the injection. Many patients notice improvement in their swelling and pain within 2 to 4 hours. However, the time it takes to work can vary from person to person. If you do not feel better after the first dose, a second dose may be given. Always follow up with your doctor if your symptoms are not improving.
special_populations: Pregnant or breastfeeding women: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. It is not fully known if this medicine is safe during pregnancy or if it passes into breast milk. Your doctor will weigh the benefits and risks with you. Children: This medicine is approved for teenagers (13 years and older) but has not been fully studied in younger children. Elderly patients: There is limited information about the use of this medicine in people over 65 years old. Your doctor will decide if this is the right treatment for you. Rabbit allergy: Do NOT use this medicine if you are allergic to rabbits or rabbit products.
